MARA: We are here to discuss the fictional Larkspur Library's evening hours. My proposal is to stay open until nine on Tuesdays and Thursdays for a six-week trial.

DEVON: I thought the proposal covered every weekday.

MARA: No, only Tuesdays and Thursdays. The draft survey showed the strongest demand on those nights, though only 146 patrons responded.

PRIYA: And the trial would begin June 4, correct?

DEVON: June 11. The maintenance contract does not change until then.

MARA: Devon is right about the date. We would use existing staff volunteers for the first two weeks, then paid rotations after June 24.

PRIYA: Has the board approved the trial?

MARA: Not yet. Today's discussion may produce a recommendation, but it is not a decision. The board votes next Wednesday.

DEVON: I recommend tracking visits, computer sessions, and staffing costs. Noise complaints might also matter, although we do not know whether evenings will produce any.

PRIYA: Agreed. I will revise the proposal with those measures and the corrected start date before the board packet is released.
